purpose: Keeps a row when every word of the query appears in its fields, optionally ignoring accents, and keeps every row for an empty query.
namedChanges: T1. textHits gains an optional third parameter options: TextHitsOptions = {} with foldAccents (default off); the fold const is match.ts line 4; when foldAccents is true it runs match.ts lines 7-10 verbatim
the default path is the 0.1.0 body, byte for byte

library.title: Text filter / search (accent-insensitive)
library.note: Answers true or false for a word found anywhere in the text; it does not rank or highlight. For word-prefix search take search-tokens.
